name: Cube World Stylized Shading
definition: A fragment shader technique that replicates the specific lighting and ambient occlusion (AO) style of the game Cube World, using a multi-band AO interpolation model rather than simple linear multiplication.
summary: Cube World Stylized Shading is a fragment shader technique that creates distinct shadow bands with specific tinting, replicating the game's unique aesthetic rather than smooth gradients.
